changelog: Aura AI v2.2.0 — Claude-Style Floating Edge-to-Edge Chat Screen & Native Voice Recording
Removed broken calling mode headphone icon from chat input while preserving the top Chat | Voice toggle
Restored native voice note recording with pulsing indicator, timer, live waveform, cancel, and stop & send
Claude Android inspired compact floating input: slim single-row pill when idle, smoothly expands into a two-row card when typing
Full-screen edge-to-edge layout: messages scroll under floating top header and bottom input with progressive gradient fades
Fixed shadow clipping and corner radius on floating input container
